text:
maria: Uploading GlyphCloud case study + co-brand asset pack for sign-off. Need: full-color + reversed logos, trademark line, and two quote lengths by EOD. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/GlyphCloud-CaseStudy

maria: Also uploaded assets to S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood/partners/glyphcloud-assets-v3.zip

partner-bot: Asset ingestion complete \u2705 (manifest: glyph-assets-v3.json). Link integrity OK.

eli: Design pass: hero lockup feels left-aligned. Requesting reversed (light-on-dark) SVG + clearspace spec from partner. Left comments in Figma. :pencil2:

sam-legal: Legal checklist: 1) written approval for quote (include name + title + explicit "OK to publish") 2) partner logo usage permission 3) confirmation quote has no PII. Any MSA marketing clause?

tara: Marketing needs short (~100 char) and long (~300 char) quote variants. Final image sizes: 1200x628 hero, 280x280 social.

maria: Received suggested quote from GlyphCloud via email: "Redwood's inference made deployment painless for our search stack 4 4x latency improvement for live queries."

maria: @sam-legal can we publish that after they confirm?

sam-legal: Need sender full name + title and explicit approval phrasing in writing. If they reply with "OK to publish" in thread or email, that's fine. Also confirm ownership of the quote.

eli: If we get approval, I'll add alt text and push reversed SVGs. Design also needs partner hex codes and spacing rules from their brand kit.

maria: Followed up with GlyphCloud asking for quote approval, brand hex + logo kit, and trademark line. Cc'd their marketing lead. Waiting on reply.

partner-bot: Reminder scheduled in 48h; approval cutoff set to 1714303600. Will auto-ping if no reply.

tara: Contingency plan: publish without partner logo (use placeholder badge) if no approval by EOD Friday. Notify sales ops.

eli: Docs-engineering snippet for lockup CSS (to push once assets locked):

```
.partner-lockup { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; }
.partner-lockup img { max-height:48px; }
@media (max-width:600px) { .partner-lockup img { max-height:36px; } }
```

eli: Added spacing notes and exported reversed SVGs (v3) in Figma comments.

maria: QA check: we will not include partner customer logos without separate opt-in. @sam-legal pls confirm.

sam-legal: Confirmed. No customer logos without explicit consent. Include partner trademark attribution exactly if required.

tara: After quote locked I'll draft social posts + email snippet. ETA ~2 hours.

maria: Will paste GlyphCloud's approval here if they respond.

partner-bot: Follow-up reminder queued for 48h. Reaction: :alarm_clock:
